## Summary

I implemented the `locality` field on the owner response for `POST /api/owners`, set to `"local"` when the owner's city is the single most common city among owners existing at registration, otherwise `"remote"`.

Changes, following the existing pattern used for the other registration-time computed fields (`membershipNumber`, `customerCode`, `sharesHousehold`, etc.):

- **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `locality` string property to the `Owner` schema, which regenerates `OwnerDto` with a `setLocality`/`getLocality`.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a static `locality(Owner, Collection<Owner>)` helper and a `@Mapping(target = "locality", ignore = true)`.
